biomarkers.name: HER2 (ERBB2)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~15-25% (generally higher in GEJ than distal gastric)

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; broadly similar to gastric/esophageal adenocarcinoma depending on CPS cutoff

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.prevalence: ~3-8% (lower than distal gastric; uncommon in GEJ)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Adenocarcinoma at the junction, sharing features with distal esophageal adenocarcinoma and proximal gastric adenocarcinoma
variants: Siewert type I (distal esophagus, treated as esophageal)
Siewert type III (proximal stomach, treated as gastric)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Standard adenocarcinoma grading; Lauren classification may be applied, though GEJ tumors are commonly intestinal-type

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Intermediate between esophageal and gastric — HER2 enrichment (~15-25%)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Metaplastic intestinal epithelium at gastroesophageal junction (similar to esophageal adeno) or gastric cardia epithelium
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intestinal-type glandular differentiation predominantly; HER2 more commonly overexpressed than in distal gastric
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same GERD/Barrett's-driven metaplasia biology as esophageal adenocarcinoma for Siewert I and many Siewert II tumors; more classic gastric cardia biology for Siewert III
